title: Reading Drill — How an Old Staircase Was Worn
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: How an Old Staircase Was Worn
passages.body:
**A** A house museum wondered why the edges of several stair treads were worn more deeply than the centres. Staff measured each tread and compared the results with old photographs of the room.

**B** The photographs showed a handrail on the outer side and a cupboard blocking part of the lower flight. A narrow walking line would have concentrated footsteps on one side for decades.

**C** The team preserved the wear instead of replacing the treads. New visitors used a second staircase, while the original route could be seen from the landing.
